# OpenFlyover

> Free, open-source web app that turns a GPS activity (GPX, TCX, FIT, KML) and photos into a
> cinematic 3D flyover video, entirely in the browser. Nothing is uploaded. MIT licence.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Khansuhai/ACTIVITY-MAPPER-/blob/main/README.md): features, browser support, data sources
- [Technical decisions](https://github.com/Khansuhai/ACTIVITY-MAPPER-/blob/main/docs/DECISIONS.md): why it works the way it does
